Qt Multimedia 6.12.0 subtitle null-pointer fix

Upstream: https://download.qt.io/official_releases/qt/6.12/6.12.0/single/qt-everywhere-src-6.12.0.tar.xz
Archive SHA-256: 98ff4f44bac6ec3e1e62ee2a4316ae0e3d15badb015d753cc0268a20db52f165
Source directory: qtmultimedia/src/plugins/multimedia/ffmpeg/

Unmodified upstream file SHA-256 values:
0ec3f8bbde614c2a4f4202042f77fbbcda51065a7c7996bf47f6b2678a224827  qffmpegplugin.cpp
b1bef03e0c3aeac3a5f0dac7d85fed68fa390317cd6f15e6f715108269634f02  ffmpeg.json
8a561ae66a7fa608d82231bb3c46b9deb64efef565cd831c00266fb89a19dee1  playbackengine/qffmpegstreamdecoder.cpp
ae54e2255f26256c346945fd3fbefc974eba6baf6a71c106526b8fc1448274f7  playbackengine/qffmpegstreamdecoder_p.h

Local changes in qffmpegstreamdecoder.cpp:
- Discard unsupported bitmap cues before enqueueing frames in the text renderer,
  releasing their FFmpeg allocations. This also avoids paused-seek stalls caused
  by treating open-ended bitmap display times as text-frame durations.
- Return empty text when both text and ASS pointers are null, preventing null
  pointer dereferences in subtitle text extraction.
All other code is unchanged. The matching patch is shipped with runtime notices.

The plugin links the remaining implementation from the exact Qt 6.12.0 kit.
